notes.title: Minor patch: Window is now resizable
notes.content: You can now resize the window and there will be letter/pillar boxing in order to preserve the intended field of vision.

notes.title: Options menu fix.
notes.content: There was a bug where it would become impossible to change anything in the options menu.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Fix for replay being included and autoplayed, rendering the level unplayable. (Thanks Rokas666666)
Fix for display artifact that sometimes showed when reloading the level.

notes.title: Small patch to fix music looping.
notes.content: Nothing big, just a small looping error on some of the tracks.
